scope: Preview resources only. Existing Test page and authoritative Visual-Spec unchanged.

observedDrift.before: dense grooves, scratches, shiny machined metal, bright bevel rims
observedDrift.target: recognizable geometric apparatus, broad matte planes, reduced grip detail, short soft shadow

observedDrift.before: glossy 3D product rendering and chrome rims
observedDrift.target: keep optical shape differences, smooth broad reflections, simple blue rim

observedDrift.before: concrete-like embossed table texture and realistic notebook material
observedDrift.target: large quiet painted planes, restrained grid, fine sparse grain

prompts.name: background
prompts.prompt: STYLE TRANSFER EDIT, not a new apparatus design. IMAGE 1 is the editable equipment/background target. IMAGE 2 (solar-system illustration) and IMAGE 3 (forms contact sheet) are STRICT drawing-style references ONLY; do not copy their people, stars, planets, lettering, logos or arrangements. Restyle IMAGE 1 into the SAME quiet scientific educational illustration family: simple geometric forms, broad flat painted color areas, only 3-4 clear tonal steps per material, restrained soft low-depth shadow, extremely subtle fine paper-grain on matte surfaces. Shallow illustrated depth, not realistic 3D render or physical metal. Palette: desaturated navy #202E4D, fog-blue #7693BA, soft lavender #ACAEDB, ice-blue #C4E3F1, muted warm gold #F4CB83 for laser aperture only. Visually reduce nonessential detail strongly: no scratches, dents, pore/crater texture, brushed chrome, metallic specular streaks, glossy plastic, neon rim lighting, tiny bolts, screw threads or densely serrated knobs. Simplify knobs to identifiable cylinders with at most 5 broad grips; necessary mounts/structure stay clear. No hard black cartoon outlines or photographic environment reflections. Preserve shape, camera/viewpoint, relative proportions, enlarged diameter, object placement and full image framing from IMAGE 1. This is restyling, not flattening into an abstract icon or removing functional supports. Preserve exact background layout: upper gridded wall, lower tabletop, notebook/pencil/eraser left, notebook right. Grid becomes finer, less contrasting and less rigidly luminous; tabletop becomes a broad blue painted plane with fine sparse paper grain, no concrete/paving/diamond texture. Stationery should be geometric painted shapes with 3 tone levels, not a photo. IMPORTANT: preserve the notebook optics sketches' exact topology and arrow directions pixel-faithfully; only adjust graphite softness, never invent or relocate ray lines or focal point. No apparatus, rail, UI or beam. Opaque background.
